description: The line plot illustrates the Overall ROUGE-G Score achieved by different models across varying numbers of training examples. The x-axis is labeled "# Training Examples" and displays discrete data points at 0, 16, and 64. The y-axis is labeled "Overall ROUGE-G Score" and features a linear scale ranging from 11.0 to 19.0, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2.0. The plot contains eight lines representing four models and their variants. The green solid line with circle markers (PELMS) starts at approximately 16.7 at 0 examples, increases to 18.4 at 16 examples, and ends at 18.7 at 64 examples. The green dashed line with circle markers (legend text obscured) begins at 16.7 at 0 examples, rises to 17.0 at 16 examples, and reaches 17.9 at 64 examples. The red solid line with square markers (Primera) starts at 15.0 at 0 examples, increases to 17.2 at 16 examples, and ends at 18.2 at 64 examples. The red dashed line with square markers (Primera (5%)) begins at 15.0 at 0 examples, dips to 14.6 at 16 examples, and rises to 15.9 at 64 examples. The blue solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers (Pegasus-X) starts at 13.6 at 0 examples, rises to 15.5 at 16 examples, and ends at 17.9 at 64 examples. The blue dashed line with upward-pointing triangle markers (Pegasus-X (5%)) begins at 13.6 at 0 examples, declines to a low of 11.6 at 16 examples, and increases to 14.1 at 64 examples. The yellow solid line with diamond markers (Centrum) starts at 15.8 at 0 examples, increases slightly to 16.0 at 16 examples, and ends at 16.4 at 64 examples. Finally, the yellow dashed line with diamond markers (Centrum (5%)) begins at 15.8 at 0 examples, remains steady at 15.8 at 16 examples, and ends slightly higher at 15.9 at 64 examples.
